anchors.name: Apple Inc.

anchors.name: Microsoft
anchors.summary: As of 2026-10-24: economics-first cloud, AI infrastructure, enterprise software and strategic-investment map. Contract and concentration candidates are separated from channels, competition and private entities. No price-latency tests performed.

anchors.name: Amazon / AWS
anchors.summary: As of 2026-10-24: cloud demand, semiconductor supply, power infrastructure, SaaS channels and strategic investments. Amazon's retail, logistics and satellite operations can dominate its consolidated stock response. No latency tests performed.

anchors.name: NVIDIA Corporation

anchors.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company

anchors.name: Salesforce, Inc.
anchors.summary: As of 2026-10-24: distinguish infrastructure, model supply, channel partners, complements, competitors, customers and private investments. Most relationship identities are confirmed but financial dependence is unquantified.

sources.title: Apple FY2023 Form 10-K
reviewed_sections: Business: markets, distribution and component supply
Risk Factors: outsourcing and component constraints
sources.claims_summary: Single/limited-source and outsourcing risks are disclosed without a named complete supplier map. End-user demand, channel inventory and product transitions should be separated.

sources.title: Apple FY2024 Form 10-K
reviewed_sections: Risk Factors: outsourcing; Google search licensing
sources.claims_summary: Google search-service licensing is explicitly named. Supply risks remain broad; supplier concentration cannot be assigned to a guessed anonymous vendor.

sources.title: Apple FY2025 Form 10-K
reviewed_sections: Business: component supply and sales channels
Risk Factors: search licensing and regulation
sources.claims_summary: Indirect channels were 60% of net sales. Search licensing and supplier concentration are distinct economic links; anonymous receivable concentrations do not identify counterparties.

sources.title: Apple reports FY2026 second-quarter results
sources.claims_summary: Quarter ended 2026-03-28: revenue $111.2B, up 17%; management described strong iPhone 17 demand. This is aggregate demand evidence, not supplier allocation.

sources.title: Apple reports FY2026 third-quarter results
sources.claims_summary: Quarter ended 2026-06-27: revenue $109.4B, up 16%. Reported margin benefited from tariff refunds, illustrating why an Apple return need not be an order shock.

sources.title: Apple FY2026 Q3 Form 10-Q
reviewed_sections: MD&A: seasonality, product introductions and component costs
sources.claims_summary: The filing describes advanced semiconductor, NAND and DRAM supply pressure and rising costs. Product/channel inventory timing can confound price-only lead-lag attribution.

sources.title: Apple Supplier List: FY2023 direct-spend coverage
reviewed_sections: Hon Hai, Luxshare, Quanta, Samsung, Skyworks, TSMC entries
sources.claims_summary: The list covers 98% of FY2023 direct materials/manufacturing/assembly spend. Listing establishes historical participation, not current component allocation or revenue shares.

sources.title: Apple increases U.S. commitment to $600B and launches AMP
reviewed_sections: US silicon chain: GlobalWafers, TI, Samsung, GlobalFoundries
sources.claims_summary: Names US wafer/fab partners and prospective capacity. Claims about first/largest customer are facility-specific; $600B is an aggregate corporate program, not individual supplier revenue.

sources.title: Apple adds new American Manufacturing Program partners
sources.claims_summary: Apple confirms Cirrus–GlobalFoundries work in Malta, New York, and additions including Qnity. New manufacturing processes include prospective capacity.

sources.title: Apple announces AMP partners for latest iPhone lineup
sources.claims_summary: Current updates distinguish ongoing supply from future projects: TSMC Arizona chips, Coherent lasers and Qnity films; Perryman commitment; Amkor Arizona construction.

sources.title: Apple and Corning: US cover-glass manufacturing
sources.claims_summary: Apple commits $2.5B toward cover-glass production in Kentucky. The agreement concerns iPhone/Watch cover glass, not every Corning business.

sources.title: Apple rare-earth magnet commitment
sources.claims_summary: A $500M multiyear procurement commitment supports MP Materials magnets and recycling. Announced spending is not immediately recognized revenue.

sources.title: Applied Materials joins Apple and Texas Instruments
reviewed_sections: Equipment supplied to TI US factories
sources.claims_summary: Applied supplies equipment to TI factories making chips for Apple, providing a verified tier-2 route. Apple-specific equipment revenue is not disclosed.

sources.title: Qualcomm agreement for Apple smartphone launches
sources.claims_summary: Qualcomm confirms Modem-RF supply for Apple smartphone launches in 2024–2026. It does not guarantee every model, socket, or future market share.

sources.title: Cirrus Logic FY2026 Form 10-K
sources.claims_summary: Apple end-demand represented 91% of FY26 sales (89% FY25; 87% FY24), through multiple contract manufacturers. Cirrus primarily sources wafers from GlobalFoundries and TSMC.

sources.title: Skyworks FY2025 Annual Report
sources.claims_summary: Indexed annual-report text reports Apple end-demand at 67% of FY25 revenue, 69% FY24 and 66% FY23. Full PDF retrieval failed; concentration passage was reviewed in search extraction.

sources.title: Chase to become Apple Card issuer
sources.claims_summary: Chase transition is expected in roughly 24 months. Goldman remains current issuer and savings provider in the disclosure; Mastercard remains the network.

sources.title: Apple current carrier launch offers
sources.claims_summary: Apple identifies AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon as current carrier-offer and activation partners. Sales/subsidy sensitivity is unquantified.

sources.title: CMBI Research Focus List, January 2026: Luxshare
sources.claims_summary: CMBI identifies Apple as a key Luxshare customer and discusses product-cycle and share-gain exposure. Forward forecasts are analyst estimates, not verified order awards.

sources.title: Broadcom expands Apple collaboration through 2031
sources.claims_summary: Broadcom confirms new long-term custom ASIC supply/development agreements through 2031. The filing does not disclose financial terms or identify every end-product.

sources.title: Apple renewed Broadcom agreement assessment
sources.claims_summary: Morningstar interprets the renewal as extending wireless/custom silicon exposure; AI-use attribution is an analyst interpretation, not established by the SEC filing.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2026 annual report
reviewed_sections: MD&A: liquidity, capital resources, contractual commitments
sources.claims_summary: Approximately 25% OpenAI interest on an as-converted basis; $24.1bn FY2026 commercial/revenue-share revenue from OpenAI and $6.0bn receivable. Capital requirements extend across data centers, servers, networking and leases. Latest report uses broad competitor classes.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2025 annual report
sources.claims_summary: Documents cloud and AI infrastructure expansion and historical OpenAI terms, including Azure API exclusivity and capacity right of first refusal. These terms must not be carried forward after subsequent amendments.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2024 annual report
reviewed_sections: Business: Productivity and Business Processes competition
sources.claims_summary: Names Amazon, Google, Broadcom, IBM and Oracle among Azure competitors; Dynamics competitors include Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow. Partners can simultaneously compete in individual products. Reviews capex, supply and cloud operating risks.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2026 Q4 earnings update
sources.claims_summary: Quarter ended 2026-06-30: revenue about $90.0bn; Intelligent Cloud grew 32%; cloud and AI expansion remained an important driver. Q4 update overlaps the annual report and is not an additional independent quarter.

sources.title: Microsoft FY2026 Q3 earnings update
sources.claims_summary: Quarter ended 2026-03-31: revenue about $82.9bn; Azure and other cloud services growth 40% reported, 39% constant currency; commercial RPO growth 99%. Aggregate metrics do not identify individual suppliers.

sources.title: Arista FY2024 10-K
sources.claims_summary: Microsoft explicitly named as 20% of FY2024 Arista revenue, versus 18% FY2023 and 16% FY2022. Historical named customer evidence; publication timestamp needs EDGAR-index completion before a point-in-time backtest.

sources.title: Arista FY2025 10-K
sources.claims_summary: Broadcom named as predominant switching-silicon vendor. FY2025 large end-customer concentrations are 26% and 16%, but names are omitted; matching to prior names is inference. EDGAR accepted 2026-02-13, official filing date 2026-02-17. VeloCloud acquired from Broadcom June 2025.

sources.title: CoreWeave FY2025 10-K
sources.claims_summary: Microsoft explicitly identified as 67% of FY2025 revenue. Prior-year percentages 62% and 35%. Filing also describes changing future customer commitments; historical concentration is not a current quarterly revenue weight.

sources.title: Nebius Microsoft commercial agreement 6-K
sources.claims_summary: Five-year dedicated capacity arrangement at Vineland. Conditional total value about $17.4bn through 2031, possibly $19.4bn with additional capacity. Delivery failures can permit termination of affected services.

sources.title: IREN signs Microsoft AI cloud contract
sources.claims_summary: Five-year Microsoft GPU services contract approximately $9.7bn, with 20% prepayment. Linked Dell equipment purchase approximately $5.8bn. NVIDIA GB300 capacity planned in phased liquid-cooled deployments through 2026.

sources.title: IREN FY2026 results and business update
sources.claims_summary: Horizon 1 delivered to Microsoft; Horizon 2 commissioning and Horizon 3-4 construction continue. Reports $3.6bn GPU financing for Microsoft contract at 6.0%. Delivery progress is separate from the original contract announcement.

sources.title: Constellation Crane PPA with Microsoft
sources.claims_summary: 20-year Microsoft power agreement supports restart of approximately 835MW Crane nuclear facility. Announced at 07:00 Eastern. It is a project-linked offtake, not proof that the restarted facility was already operating.

sources.title: Brookfield and Microsoft renewable framework
sources.claims_summary: Brookfield Asset Management and Brookfield Renewable collaborate with Microsoft on more than 10.5GW new renewable capacity, initially U.S./Europe 2026-2030. Framework scale is not an executed PPA at every site or a disclosed revenue allocation among Brookfield vehicles.

sources.title: Eaton and Microsoft grid-interactive data centers
sources.claims_summary: Names Microsoft Boydton pilot involving Eaton EnergyAware UPS and battery storage to provide grid services. Does not disclose material Microsoft customer revenue or a fleet-wide equipment procurement.

sources.title: 3M and Microsoft AI infrastructure partnership
sources.claims_summary: Microsoft announced as first hyperscale cloud deployer of 3M Expanded Beam Optical technology. 3M also adopts Microsoft AI/digital capabilities. Purchase volume and revenue concentration undisclosed.

sources.title: Azure NVIDIA GB300 cluster deployment
sources.claims_summary: Operational Azure cluster links more than 4,600 Blackwell Ultra GPUs using NVIDIA scale-up/scale-out networking. Confirms actual deployment, not a disclosed Microsoft share of NVIDIA revenue.

sources.title: AMD MI300X in Azure
sources.claims_summary: Azure ND MI300X V5 instances generally available; Microsoft uses AMD GPU and ROCm capabilities for AI workloads. Does not disclose customer concentration or purchases.

sources.title: NVIDIA FY2026 10-K manufacturing
sources.claims_summary: Names TSMC and Samsung wafer foundries; memory suppliers SK hynix, Micron and Samsung; and assembly/packaging partners. Supports a company-level second-tier foundry path, not a fab/node allocation for every Microsoft GPU.

sources.title: AI infrastructure investment partnership launch
sources.claims_summary: Microsoft, BlackRock/GIP and MGX launch infrastructure investment partnership. Seeks $30bn equity over time, potentially $100bn including debt; targets are neither Microsoft commitments of that amount nor completed fundraising.

sources.title: Accenture, Microsoft and Avanade Copilot practice
sources.claims_summary: Launches 5,000-person Copilot transformation practice involving Accenture and Avanade, their joint venture with Microsoft. Implementation services complement Microsoft adoption, but AI automation may also pressure service hours.

sources.title: RISE with SAP on Azure initiative expanded
sources.claims_summary: Expands joint RISE with SAP on Azure initiative, first publicly announced January 2025. Indicates cloud hosting and migration cooperation, not an exclusive provider relationship or quantified revenue dependence.

sources.title: Oracle Database@Azure enhanced
sources.claims_summary: Oracle database services run on OCI inside Azure data centers; update expands data/AI integration. Microsoft and Oracle remain product competitors while cooperating on distribution.

sources.title: Microsoft October 2025 OpenAI amendment
sources.claims_summary: October 28 recapitalization disclosure: approximately 27% OpenAI diluted interest, incremental $250bn Azure purchase commitment, removal of Microsoft capacity right of first refusal. Historical terms precede April 2026 amendment and later dilution.

sources.title: Microsoft April 2026 OpenAI amendment
sources.claims_summary: Microsoft remains primary cloud partner; OpenAI may serve products across clouds. IP license becomes non-exclusive; Microsoft no longer pays revenue share to OpenAI; OpenAI-to-Microsoft share continues through 2030 subject to a cap.

sources.title: Microsoft NVIDIA Anthropic strategic partnerships
sources.claims_summary: Anthropic commits $30bn Azure compute and additional capacity up to 1GW. Microsoft commits investment up to $5bn, NVIDIA up to $10bn. Commitment is not proof all funds were paid or all future capacity delivered.

sources.title: Snowflake FY2026 10-K
sources.claims_summary: Snowflake operates on AWS, Azure and GCP; negotiated infrastructure prices influence gross margin and some cloud providers also compete. No individual Azure revenue concentration disclosed in reviewed sections.

sources.title: Corning Microsoft hollow-core fiber manufacturing
sources.claims_summary: Corning North Carolina fiber/cable facilities to manufacture Microsoft's hollow-core fiber, supporting scale across Azure network. Revenue size not disclosed; physical optical latency is distinct from equity-price reaction latency.

sources.title: Avanade majority ownership explanation
